title: 16″ 9mm Preemo Clear Embossed Logo Beaker Bong
description:
Borosilicate glass
Open-ended downstem
Herb bowl
Thickness: 9mm
16 inch base diameter: 125mm
Color: clear
These are elegant Preemo clear beaker bongs with the logo embossed on the tube. The glass is 9mm thick and super sturdy. They come with a herb bowl, ice pinches and an open-ended down stem.
